t: Erbauer EXT 18V 5.0Ah Li-Ion battery is an essential power source for cordless tools, offering reliable and sustained performance on the job site. Featuring Keep Cool Technology, the Erbauer 18V battery extends runtime and reduces heat stress, significantly increasing overall battery life. It ensures uninterrupted maximum power delivery throughout the entire discharge cycle, which is ideal for trade professionals undertaking prolonged drilling or cutting tasks. A clear battery charge indicator provides real-time feedback on remaining capacity, helping to maximise efficiency and planning. The versatile 5.0Ah battery is compatible with all Erbauer 18V EXT products.
